--item-index.purpose: Position of a navigation item, set inline at render for the staggered sidebar entry

--ancestors-index.purpose: The --item-index of the top-level ancestor, captured so nested items stagger after it

exceptions.reason: Consumer syntax highlighters (for example Shiki or Prism) style pre/code inline or in unlayered CSS, which outranks every layered rule

exceptions.standard: STD-UIP-STY-001 section 3, Governed values (local geometry); STD-UIP-TKN-001 section 3, Dimension vocabulary
exceptions.reason: Paint order inside the tab's own stacking context (isolation: isolate): -1 draws the hover pill behind the label; it is not a stacking layer of the page
exceptions.removal: None; this is local paint order, not a layer

exceptions.standard: ADR-UIP-VIS-001 item 6 (guarded floors: shapes that carry meaning are anatomy, not hooks); STD-UIP-TKN-001 2.7.0
exceptions.reason: The status dot is anatomy: its round shape and 6px size mark a live status, so no hook may change them
exceptions.removal: None; a meaningful shape stays anatomy

exceptions.standard: WCAG 2.2 SC 4.1.3 (status messages); ADR-UIP-VIS-001 item 6 (guarded floors)
exceptions.reason: The status region is visually hidden: its 1px box is the visually-hidden technique that keeps the option count in the accessibility tree, not a design value
exceptions.removal: None; this is the visually-hidden technique, not design
